facts.text: I want to monetize an uncopyable QR code where each instance is 100% unique and cannot be recreated.
I want a specialized but simple reader to ingest the uncopyable QR code.
I want the reader to trigger an action via an API once the reader has authenticated the QR code.
I have ideas about authenticating physical goods throughout a sensitive supply chain.
I have ideas about authenticating high value luxury items such as a Birkin bag.
I am considering using NFTs as an alternative approach.
I want to attach one of these QR codes to a collectable trading card.
I want the trading card to have some value in a video game.
I want a special skin to be available in a video game if someone has the card.
I want a tabletop card game to allow play if someone has the card.
I am asking whether the QR-code-based card needs to be an NFT.
I am concerned about a scenario where someone owns the card, generates the associated NFT, and then sells the NFT without transferring the card.
I want to know which companies generate high value collectables.
I want to know whether those companies actively create new collectables or focus on trading old ones.
I want to discuss industrial goods and identify which industries are most concerned with using counterfeit products.

keyphrases: QR code attached to trading card
create new collectables vs trade old ones
